webpage.text:
Christmas Travel Forecast | Weather Blog

Happy holidays and Merry Christmas! The weather is looking pretty quiet heading into the holiday.  Cold this Thursday, with temperatures only in the 20s. We do expect widespread light snow Thursday night, with a general 1-3" of accumulation. The snow looks to come to an end before Friday morning.

For folks traveling over the next three days, expect dry weather on Friday. Cloudy and not as cold, with highs in the mid 30s. Low pressure approaches from the west on Christmas Eve night, bringing widespread light rain with the chance of a wintry mix north and east of Utica overnight. Temperatures only drop into the low 30s on Friday night.

Christmas Day looks mild and wet, with widespread rain. Temperatures climb into the mid 30s. Rain continues into Saturday night, changing to snow showers on Sunday.

Sunday's forecast looks cloudy and unsettled, with a few snow showers expected. Breezy, with temperatures in the 30s.

Looking ahead, the weather continues to stay milder than average as our winter remains driven by a La Niña weather pattern.
